why: Options 1-4 all contain leaf (petal) shapes made of curved lines. Option 5 is only a straight double-headed arrow with no leaf at all. The arrow in option 4 is extra, but option 4 still has leaves.
trick: Find the shape that appears in almost every figure; the figure without it is the answer.
